description: the flying carpet of old Slavic fairy tales come alive, a long red woven carpet with gold and blue folk patterns and long tassels, flying and curling like a snake ready to strike, two glowing eyes in its pattern, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, flying, full body, three-quarter view, the carpet alone, no rider, no ground, no background, the whole carpet inside the picture
